title: Miracles, passion and resurrection
note: The Gospels report Jesus' miracles as signs of God's kingdom. All four then slow down for his last week: the entry into Jerusalem, the Last Supper, his arrest, trials and crucifixion under Pontius Pilate, his burial, and the empty tomb on the first day of the week, followed by appearances to his followers.
